name: MedBullets
intro: MedBullets是论文与JAMA Clinical Challenge同时提出但独立统计的医学问答数据集，包含308道2022年4月至2023年12月公开的Medbullets Step 2/3模拟临床题。每题含病例描述、五个选项、正确答案和解释所有选项的专家解析；论文另构造四选项版本，并分别评测答案准确率与解释质量。
metric: Accuracy, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, BLEURT, BARTScore, CTC, G-Eval
eval_feature: 答案与解释联合评测, 三种提示策略, 自动与人工解释评估
eval_feature_en: Joint answer and explanation evaluation, three prompting strategies, automatic and human rationale assessment
intro_en: MedBullets is a medical QA dataset introduced alongside, but counted separately from, JAMA Clinical Challenge. It contains 308 publicly available Medbullets Step 2/3 simulated clinical questions from April 2022 through December 2023. Each item includes a case description, five choices, the correct answer, and an expert explanation covering all options; the paper also creates a four-choice variant and evaluates both answer accuracy and explanation quality.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.18060 and the official ChallengeClinicalQA repository. The diagrams keep Medbullets as a 308-item English Step 2/3 dataset collected from publicly linked posts dated April 2022 through December 2023, exclude image-dependent cases, retain the case, five choices, answer, and option-level expert rationale, create Medbullets-5 and a four-choice variant by removing one incorrect option, and explicitly keep the 1,524-item 13-domain JAMA Clinical Challenge as a separate companion track. They preserve the seven evaluated LLMs, direct X-to-Y, two-stage X-to-R-to-Y, and gold-conditioned explanation prompting, zero-, two-, and five-shot settings with leave-one-out examples, answer Accuracy, the ROUGE-L/BERTScore/BLEURT/BARTScore/CTC/G-Eval explanation suite, and the 30-item, two-model, three-rating-per-output human study of completeness, correctness, and relevance.
